scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have to got a job to complete the event.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
抱歉，要先转职才能完成这个活动。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have already completed the event.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
抱歉，你已经完成过这个活动了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Greetings fellow lively human.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
你好，活生生的人类朋友。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Halloween is upon us and it is almost time to adventure out into places few dare go.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
万圣节就要到了，是时候去那些鲜有人敢涉足的地方冒险了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Trick or treat, which do you prefer?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
恶作剧还是礼物，你选哪一个？

scripts.text: Trick
scripts.translation: 恶作剧

scripts.text: Treat
scripts.translation: 礼物

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a trick. Why don't you go pick a treat now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
你已经体验过恶作剧了，现在选份礼物吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Give me a min...
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
请稍等...

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Here is your treat. Your Base EXP has been slightly increased.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
这是你的礼物，基本经验值增加了一点。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I hope you enjoy your trick and Happy Halloween!
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
希望你喜欢这场恶作剧，万圣节快乐！

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a treat. Why don't you go pick a trick now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
你已经领过礼物了，现在试试恶作剧吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Great! This shall be so much fun.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
太好了！这会非常有趣。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Did you get the items I requested or do you need to see the list again?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
我要的物品拿到了吗？
还是想再看一遍清单？

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I will be sending you on a scavenger hunt for items.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
我要让你去找一些物品。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Bring back all the necessary items, and I will create you a treat.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
把材料带齐，我就为你制作一份礼物。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Not just any normal treat either that you can eat, but it is something you can wear on your head.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
可不是普通的糖果，而是能戴在头上的东西。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
But with all things made, some items are required first.
The list:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
不过，制作东西总得先备好材料。
清单如下：
1 顶帽子，
30 个南瓜，
20 个黑色布料。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Hurry along now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
快去吧。

scripts.text: Got'em
scripts.translation: 拿到了

scripts.text: Don't Have
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text: See List
scripts.translation: 查看清单

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
You don't have enough items. Come back when you do.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
材料还不够，收集齐再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Good job! I hope you are happy with your item.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
干得好！希望你喜欢这份礼物。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Enjoy the rest of your Halloween.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
继续享受万圣节吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Go back out and search for them. Would you like to view the list?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
再出去找找吧。
要看看清单吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I require the following items:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
需要以下材料：
1 顶帽子，
30 个南瓜，
20 个黑色布料。
